reason: The unchanged NAudio.Core getter calls TimeSpan.FromSeconds(double). Unity Framework rounds to the nearest millisecond; the original .NET 10 result retains sub-millisecond ticks.
rule: For these positive durations only: monoTicks == ((originalTicks + 5000) // 10000) * 10000, and abs(monoTicks-originalTicks) <= 5000.
scope: TotalTime observations only. PCM, sample counts, byte positions, read return values, buffer contents, metadata and exceptions must remain byte-identical.
